name: @meshnet/mobile
//: The phone shell, iOS and Android: Capacitor around the built client, with the BLE plugin the client calls. No `build`, `typecheck` or `test` script: `pnpm -r` runs on machines with no Xcode and no Android SDK. An iOS build needs a Mac.

scripts.sync: pnpm --filter @meshnet/meshcore build && pnpm --filter @meshnet/web build && cap sync
